body:
| Option | Tradeoff |
|---|---|
| Keep JSX wrapper, debug deeper into rehype-raw stitching | Fragile — each release of remark / rehype could re-break it; the fundamental block-edge issue is in the spec, not the libraries. |
| Take outline as a `data="..."` attribute on `<MindMap>` | HTML attribute parsing struggles with multi-line content (Rule 3 — single-line opening tags). Authors would either escape newlines or write everything on one line. Awful UX. |
| **Add a fenced ` ```mindmap ` lang handler** | Code fences are first-class CommonMark blocks. The lang handler receives the raw text body untouched. Same pattern as `chart`, `kanban`, `mermaid`, `csv`, `schema` — already familiar to authors. |
| Replace `<MindMap>` entirely with the fenced form | Breaking change. Cheap to keep both forms working — the wrapper is the alternative path with a clear fallback message that points to the preferred form. |
